name: Glute Bridge Hold
instructions: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat and hip-width apart.
Lift your hips into a full glute bridge — knees, hips, shoulders in line.
Hold the top position, squeezing the glutes, for the prescribed time.
Breathe steadily; don't let the hips sag. An isometric glute strengthener.
longevityNotes: A strong hinge is back insurance. Learn it light, groove it often, and add load slowly — the goal is a back that never complains about picking things up.
overview: A beginner bodyweight hinge-pattern exercise for the glutes. Glute Bridge Hold builds posterior-chain strength that protects your back in everyday lifting.
